question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only five people sit between C and D. B sits third from the right end. G sits to the immediate right of C. E sits third to the right of A. How many people sit between G and F?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only five people sit between C and D.

G sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9441ebd06cc25c0a4e4ccc03a99235637b171ac3d1a46403182385294d8c192a.png] 

B sits third from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6f18c830127e0eae7b0dc6c14789253316a34e7f4b64ef2c246dbf0b9ab6d9b.png] 

E sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9a2a91abf719cff04ef48d3a1d7af9f4e365b870147152e36d80e4c58b9c183.png] 

Thus final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7c255f954325214967145e4188a77126ad7cd18b38beff5ab89b8c99277026.png] 

So, **One **people sit between G and F.

Hence, the correct answer is "One
